profile.headline: Software Developer/Independent Game Designer and Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the banking and medical industries

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Java · Salesforce.com · Salesforce.com Development · C#

positions.title: Java Application Developer II
positions.description:
* Performed the technical design and development of complex application systems using existing and emerging technology platforms. 
* Assisted in the creation of comprehensive unit test plans, and created and executed test cases in line with test plans. 
* Participated in coding, testing, implementation, and documentation of solutions. 
* Ensured that expected application performance levels are achieved. 
* Participated in investigation, analysis, and resolution of technical problems related to system functions, programming, and procedures. 
* Assisted in monitoring operating efficiency of existing systems. 
* Proactively identified opportunities for improvement and recommends technical solutions.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
* Oversaw use and maintenance of technical equipment
* Trained staff and DJs on proper use of equipment
* Assisted staff and DJs with technical issues

positions.title: Tech Assistant II
positions.description:
* Provided technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware.
* Responded to queries either in person or via e-mail.
* Wrote training manuals and documentation
* Trained faculty and students in use of online learning management software

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
* Anticipated customer and store needs by constantly evaluating environment and customers for cues.
* Communicated information to manager so that the team could respond as necessary to create the Third Place environment during each shift.
* Assisted with new partner training by positively reinforcing successful performance and giving respectful and encouraging coaching as needed.
* Provided feedback to store manager on partner performance during shift.
* Contributed to positive team environment by recognizing alarms or changes in partner morale and performance and communicating them to the store manager.
* Created a positive learning environment by providing clear, specific, timely and respectful coaching and feedback to partners on shift to ensure operational excellence and to improve partner performance.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Developed OpenDAoC open software project as a main contributor. 

Major refactor of a legacy open source codebase (Dawn of Light) to convert it to a performant, more modern architecture. 
Complete overhaul of core game systems to match new architecture and target patch level.
Implemented new game systems and features from scratch to match design specifications for public server.
